newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj gears up for privatization-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj gears up for privatization-paper.

text.p: The shareholders of Rio de Janeiro's state bank Banerj have approved a 200 million reais capital injection for the bank's brokerage arm which is to be transformed into a bank and sold off, a newspaper said.

Under the privatization model Banerj's business and assets will be transfered to its brokerage arm Banerj Distribuidora de Titulos e Valores Mobiliarios which will be sold off at a privatization auction December 12.

At the shareholders meeting, minority shareholders protested against the privatization of Banerj, fearing they will be left only with the bank's liabilities which are not being transfered to the new bank, Gazeta Mercantil said.

Private investment bank Bozano, Simonsen, which has administered Banerj since January with the aim to clean up its books ahead of privatization, assured them heir rights would be respected, Gazeta Mercantil said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
